verifications.claim: id: PAT_BAGAYOKO; nameMain: Bagayoko; nameSystem: clan_name; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: clan

candidates.title: Baghayogho: A Soninke Muslim Diaspora in the Mande World
candidates.author: Andreas W. Massing
candidates.quote: the sources are clear on their Wangara-Soninke origin
candidates.supports: Attests Baghayogho (a close spelling of Bagayoko) as a family name of Wangara-Soninke origin, with the Bagdad etymology given as an oral claim by Wasulu elders, and Hunwick's contrary view that the family is of Malinke stock. Page opened 2026-11-08 (first 100 000 characters read). Already cited in the fiche as massing-2004-baghayogho; it does not state the transmission mode.

verifications.reviewNote: Opened the OpenEdition page and checked the quote. The spelling Baghayogho is not identical to Bagayoko.
